item.title: D2 BOYS WRESTLING: Berwick’s Ramos secures upset to reach semis on Day 1
item.description: PLAINS TWP. — Berwick’s Jamir Ramos new it was a tall task for a No. 7 seed to make it to the District 2 Class 2A boys wrestling semifinals, especially when the Bulldogs senior lost to his quarterfinal opponent by first-period pin during the regular season. Ramos had his doubts before the match, but when the time came he believed in himself. item.title: D2 BOYS BASKETBALL: Crestwood downs Pittston Area; Dallas wins at buzzer
item.description: It was another typical game between Pittston Area and Crestwood. Only this time a spot in the District 2 Class 5A championship game was on line. Once again defense carried the night and it was Ayden Agapito’s game-high 18 points that lifted Creatwood to a 41-33 victory Friday night at Crestwood.
